decisions: Ruling: Normalize U1–U8 headings to Task N: UN so skill scripts can extract briefs — no scope or behavior change — cost if wrong: documentation labels only.

Task 4: Ruling: Extract crate-private audio_timing from U3 to share exact audio target computation with audio_filter(video,audio), and guard settb intermediate integer precision — avoids duplicate formulas and precision loss before setpts — cost if wrong: unsupported extreme timelines may be rejected more conservatively. RED intermediate-overflow case observed before fix.
Task 5: Ruling: Apply clippy-required test ordering and is_multiple_of in U4 video test module during native gate — no product semantics change — cost if wrong: test organization only.

Task 6: Ruling: Add hook-internal getSnapshot() reader alongside the planned UI state — starting in the same event as opening/saving must observe the ref lock before React renders — cost if wrong: extra internal hook method to maintain, no wire change.

Task 6: Ruling: Preserve frozen badge for legacy running snapshots when preset is now correctly unknown — a small ProcessingView condition is needed before U7 so existing remount behavior stays visible — cost if wrong: duplicate frozen status badge only.

Task 8: Ruling: Uniform-speed average rate must agree exactly with decoded count/effective duration, while its target duration keeps the approved transformed-one-frame tolerance; exact PTS digest remains mandatory — native MP4 retains nominal final-frame duration after setpts, making exact source-average×speed equality stronger than spec §6.3 — cost if wrong: only final-frame duration differences within the already approved frame tolerance are accepted. Native RED captured in u8-speed-red.log; U3 wrong-rate assertion remains. FFmpeg setpts source reference: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/master/libavfilter/setpts.c .

Task 8: Ruling: Use per-channel Rubber Band for custom tempo/pitch, retaining the same frozen pitch ratio and speed — atempo experiment lost 2135 samples on generated 5.1 silence, Rubber Band lost 711 with the same target, within the single 1024-sample bounded pad; both locked buildconfs enable librubberband — cost if wrong: custom audio texture differs from the initial implementation; old presets unchanged and frequency/tail tests gate it.

Task 8: Ruling: For exact custom audio counts, exclude a leading native AAC packet only when target/observed start differ by exactly 1024 samples (±1 sample), never the 50ms mux tolerance — positive-start MP4 exposes priming without skip side data — cost if wrong: an artificial file with the same exact start/duration pattern could be interpreted as encoder priming; truncated-tail negative control must still fail.
